source.note: Tokens recorded from the <style> block of static/preview.html (light :root and the prefers-color-scheme: dark override). Frontmatter carries light values; colorMeta.<token>.dark carries the dark set; schemeInvariant marks tokens that do not change.

figure.purpose: The number in a stat tile; 20px under 480px.

page-title.purpose: The one h1 per page, and the help dialog's h2.

card-title.purpose: Card and report titles, empty-state heading, drop-zone lead, help h3.

body.purpose: Copy, inputs, selects, the month stepper, sidebar items (500).

nav.purpose: Sidebar items; 600 when current; 13px as mobile tabs.

control.purpose: Buttons, chips, tile labels, hints, sub-lines, messages.

table.purpose: Every table body; the Log and the calls sheet.

label.purpose: Form labels, tags, as-of dates, footnotes, chart axis text.

column-head.purpose: Uppercase th and band rows (+0.05em); sidebar group labels (+0.06em).

mono.purpose: Inline code and the paste / SQL textareas only.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Popover menus, tooltips, the map legend and the help dialog; never on a resting card.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inputs, selects and textareas on :focus-visible, with the border turned accent.

shadows.name: error-ring
shadows.purpose: select.needs: a required select left empty.

shadows.name: hairline-divider
shadows.purpose: Stat strip cells; a line drawn with box-shadow, not depth.

shadows.name: sticky-head
shadows.purpose: Sticky table headers; the hairline that survives scrolling.

shadows.name: map-pin
shadows.purpose: Leaflet pins on the fixed light map canvas only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: background, border-color, color and box-shadow on nav items, buttons, inputs, chips and the drop zone.

motion.name: log-swap
motion.purpose: .log-wrap.swap drops to 40% opacity instantly when the month or office changes; removing the class fades back over 180ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes every transition and the pulse.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a sticky top bar with a scrolling tab row; main padding 16px.

breakpoints.name: calls-top
breakpoints.purpose: The calls page's two-column top stacks.

breakpoints.name: map-legend
breakpoints.purpose: Map legend narrows; inset map shrinks.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Stat strips go two-up, figures 20px, page-action buttons 30px.

icons.style: 16x16 viewBox, 1.5-px stroke inline (nav, help, stepper arrows at 1.8), currentColor, round caps and joins; no fill except the dot, triangles and grip.
icons.maskRecipe: display:inline-block; font-size:0; background:currentColor; mask:var(--i) center / contain no-repeat;
icons.renderedSizes: 8px (benchmark mark), 10px (sort after-icon, grip), 12px (arrow, target flag, move and year buttons), 14px (check flag, stepper arrows), 16px (nav).

narrative.overview:
This is the finance desk of a dental group rendered as a single working screen in the Stripe Dashboard / Looker Studio canon, played straight. A committed navy sidebar says where you are; a page header carries the scope (office, month) and the actions; everything below is figures first: stat strips, then tables, then charts and maps. Density is desk-grade for the analyst (a 13-px Log with 6/8-px cells, sticky headers and a pinned office column) and still readable on a phone for the owners who open the viewer link, where the sidebar folds into a top bar with a scrolling tab row and the same cards stack.

The world is restrained on purpose. One system sans family in six sizes with tabular numerals; a cool slate canvas; white cards drawn with a single hairline; one blue-violet accent that marks the primary action, the current place in the sidebar, links and focus, and nothing else. State colours do jobs (green ok, amber warning, red error) and are paired with a shape or a word, never used alone. Nothing is decorated: no gradients beyond a flat 7% band tint, no drop shadows on resting surfaces, no entrance choreography. Motion is a 150-ms state change and a 180-ms fade when the month changes.

The rejections are confirmed by the user and by the build: nothing flashy, no second accent, no nested cards, no decorative shadows or gradients, no glyph icons, and never a patient name or phone number on screen.
keyCharacteristics: A 232-px flat navy sidebar with grouped navigation (Work / Reports / Admin), the brand mark at top, help at the foot; it becomes a sticky top bar under 900 px.
One accent (`accent`) for primary fills, the current nav item (a 32% accent tint over the navy), focus outlines and selection; its deeper text form (`accent-ink`) for links and quiet actions.
Six type sizes (12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 24 px) in one system sans with `tabular-nums` everywhere; monospace only for code and the paste / SQL textareas.
Cards are a 1-px hairline on white; floating surfaces (menus, tooltips, the help dialog) carry the one `--shadow` and no border; in dark mode the shadow grows a 1-px ring.
Every control is 32 px tall with a 6-px radius; compact variants are 28 px; chips and counts are pills.
Tables with quiet uppercase 12-px headers, hairline rows, right-aligned tabular numbers; the Log pins its headers, its office column and its total row.
Stat strips are one card divided by hairlines: a 13-px muted label over a 24-px figure, no tile radius, no tile shadow.
Icons are an authored 16-px SVG set (inline for nav and a few controls, `mask-image` custom properties for the rest), drawn at 1.5 / 1.8 stroke, painted in `currentColor`.
Light and dark token sets are both normative; the sidebar tokens and the map canvas do not change with the scheme.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only accent. It marks the primary action, the current place, focus, selection and links; it never colours data except as the single chart series, and no second accent is introduced for emphasis.

rules.name: The Jobs-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only when they report a state (ok, warning, error / benchmark on target, close, below), and the state is also carried by a word, a mark or a shape. Decorative use of a state colour is a defect.

rules.name: The Constant Shell Rule
rules.body: The sidebar's five tokens and the map's three are the same in light and dark mode. Everything else must be expressed through a token that the dark block re-maps; a fixed hex outside the shell and the map is a defect.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: Type is set at 12, 13, 14, 16, 20 or 24 px (plus 12.5 px mono). A new element takes the nearest step; it does not add a seventh.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers are right-aligned (`td.num`, `th.num`) and tabular everywhere, including tooltips and tiles, so differences between rows are visible without reading.

rules.name: The Hairline-or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface has a 1-px border or the floating shadow, never both and never a second shadow value. Cards and controls get the line; menus, tooltips and dialogs get the shadow.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: The sidebar, the page canvas and the stat strips are flat. Depth is reserved for things that are temporarily above the page.

rules.name: The Four Radii Rule
rules.body: 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 px and the pill. A new container takes 10, a new control 6, a new floating note 8; tiles inside a strip take none.

dos: Do build a familiar working-tool dashboard in the Stripe / Looker canon: sidebar, page header with scope and actions, tiles, then tables.
Do put the figure first: a 24-px tabular number over a 13-px muted label, right-aligned numbers in every table, source and as-of beside the value.
Do use the same vocabulary on every tab: 32-px controls with a 6-px radius, 10-px cards with one hairline, 12-px uppercase column heads, pills for chips and counts.
Do express colour through the tokens so the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block re-maps it; only the sidebar and the map keep fixed values.
Do pair every state colour with a word, a mark or a shape (the benchmark dot / triangles, the data-check triangle, "ok" / "missing" text).
Do draw icons from the authored 16-px SVG set, inline or through the `--i-*` masks, in `currentColor`.
Do keep motion to 150-ms state changes, the 180-ms Log swap and the skeleton pulse, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do give every scrolling table a sticky header, and the Log its pinned office column and total row.
Do write empty states that explain what to do next, and show skeleton rows while data loads.
donts: Don't add anything flashy: no gradients beyond the flat 7% band tint and the mobile nav's scroll fade, no decorative shadows, no glows, no entrance choreography.
Don't introduce a second accent; emphasis is weight, size or the one indigo.
Don't nest a card inside a card; compose a table card from hairline-separated bands instead.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface or a border on a floating one.
Don't add a seventh type size, a display face or a second sans; the system stack at 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 24 px is the whole ramp.
Don't render an icon as a Unicode glyph or an icon font; the mask set exists for exactly that.
Don't use `warn` for a data check or `chk` for a benchmark; the orange belongs to the checks alone.
Don't surface a patient name or a phone number anywhere in the interface, including tooltips, exports previews and map popups.
Don't darken the map canvas in dark mode; its colour ramp needs the light ground.
